item.title: Migrating the American Express Payment Network, Twice
item.description:
📝 Context: The Payments Network The payments network is a mission-critical distributed system responsible for processing critical payments traffic, including live card authorization. Migration #1: From the Legacy Payments Network to the New Platform The first migration involved transitioning live card authorization traffic from the legacy payments network to a new, modernized platform. Payments Processing Platform The payments processing platform is where the complex, business-critical payment processing logic lives.
🔗 Read more: https://americanexpress.io/migrating-the-payments-network-twice/
